typecheck.command: pnpm --filter @miralith/site typecheck; pnpm --filter @miralith/coscroll-scene typecheck; pnpm --filter @miralith/radio-gaga-scene typecheck

focusedAccessE2E.command: CI=1 MIRALITH_PLAYWRIGHT_PORT=3125 pnpm exec playwright test -c playwright.config.ts tests/e2e/chapter-transition.spec.ts tests/e2e/chapter-navigation.spec.ts --project=desktop --workers=1 --grep 'a valid preview session expands the CoScroll review rail|a valid preview session keeps ArtBreeze visible|a known preview history target stays native|preview access admits the ArtBreeze review link|public access rejects ArtBreeze warmup'

fullDesktopBaselineComparison.command: CI=1 MIRALITH_PLAYWRIGHT_PORT=<isolated-port> pnpm exec playwright test -c playwright.config.ts tests/e2e/chapter-transition.spec.ts tests/e2e/chapter-navigation.spec.ts --project=desktop
fullDesktopBaselineComparison.note: The candidate has five additional Unit 2C cases. Full-suite failure counts are not used as a pass claim because the target baseline is already red. The access-specific focused suite passed.

baselineReadinessReproduction.command: CI=1 MIRALITH_PLAYWRIGHT_PORT=<isolated-port> pnpm exec playwright test -c playwright.config.ts tests/e2e/chapter-transition.spec.ts --project=desktop --workers=1 --repeat-each=3 --grep 'the veil locks target input until a real Radio Gaga frame is ready'
baselineReadinessReproduction.conclusion: The deterministic waiting-ready failure predates Unit 2C and was not introduced or hidden by its resolver integration.

public and preview history fail-closed behavior
explicitlyExcluded: 03 to 04 destination readiness and route shell
